label: git-tree-import-key-binding
command:
import ast,json,pathlib,re,hashlib
base=pathlib.Path("/private/tmp/localos-git-history-verified-20260921.qZcoBF")
blob="738bf1da9e62b8c511bbdb7e9451831a1b7938e1"
raw=(base/"tree-only-blobs"/blob).read_bytes()
try:
 tree=ast.parse(raw.decode("utf-8"))
except SyntaxError:
 raise SystemExit("AST parse failed; content withheld") from None
imports=[{"module":n.module,"names":[x.name for x in n.names]} for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.ImportFrom) and any(x.name=="import_report" for x in n.names)]
assign=[n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=="IMPORT_KEY" for t in n.targets)]
assert len(assign)==1 and isinstance(assign[0].value,ast.Constant) and isinstance(assign[0].value.value,str)
v=assign[0].value.value
report=json.loads((base/"tree-blobs-redacted.json").read_text())
f=[x for x in report if pathlib.Path(x["File"]).name==blob and x["StartLine"]==38]
assert len(f)==1 and f[0]["Secret"]=="REDACTED"
f=f[0]
line=raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines()[37]
redacted=line.replace(v,"REDACTED")
print(json.dumps({"blob":blob,"source_sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"assignment_line":assign[0].lineno,"import_report_origin":imports,"literal_shape":{"length":len(v),"human_identifier":bool(re.fullmatch(r"[a-z][a-z0-9_-]+",v)),"has_batch_date":bool(re.search(r"20[0-9]{6}",v)),"starts_riderra":v.startswith("riderra"),"has_auth_prefix":bool(re.match(r"(?i)(eyJ|ghp_|sk-|bearer)",v))},"binding":{"line_occurrences":line.count(v),"match_redaction_in_redacted_line":f["Match"] in redacted,"match_trim_redaction_in_redacted_line":f["Match"].strip() in redacted,"match_newlines":f["Match"].count("\n"),"match_length":len(f["Match"]),"source_line_length":len(line),"start_column":f["StartColumn"],"end_column":f["EndColumn"]},"values_withheld":True},indent=2))
